tool_analysis:
Step Analysis:
The recorded steps demonstrate creating a new GitLab project through the web interface. The agent successfully:
1. Navigated to the new project creation page
2. Filled in project name, custom slug, description
3. Selected visibility level (Internal)
4. Toggled README checkbox
5. Clicked create project button
6. Successfully created project after adjusting for duplicate name

Task Definition:
Create a reusable tool that creates GitLab projects with customizable parameters for name, slug, description, visibility, and README initialization.

Action Plan:
1. Navigate to new project creation page
2. Input project name
3. Input project slug (customizable, not auto-generated)
4. Input project description
5. Select visibility level (Private/Internal/Public)
6. Toggle README checkbox (initialize with README or not)
7. Click create project button
8. Verify successful creation

Variable Identification:
Based on the steps, we need these input parameters:
- project_name (required): Name of the project
- project_slug (required): Custom URL slug for the project
- project_description (optional): Description of the project
- visibility_level (required): Visibility setting (Private/Internal/Public)
- initialize_with_readme (optional): Whether to initialize with README file

Step Optimization:
- All steps are essential for project creation
- Element hashes are available for all form fields, making steps deterministic
- No unnecessary steps - all interactions are required for the core task
- No URL manipulation optimization possible since this is a form submission (POST request)
- The tool should handle the form filling and submission sequentially
name: create_gitlab_project
description: Creates a new GitLab project with user-provided name, slug, description, visibility settings, and README initialization option

steps.description: Navigate to GitLab new project creation page
Enter project name into the name input field
Enter custom project slug/URL into the slug input field
Enter project description into the textarea field
Select visibility level - this element corresponds to Internal visibility (value 10)
Toggle README checkbox based on initialize_with_readme parameter
Click create project button to submit the form

input_schema.name: project_slug
input_schema.description: Custom URL slug for the project (e.g., 'my-project-2025')

input_schema.name: visibility_level
input_schema.description: Project visibility level: Private (0), Internal (10), or Public (20)

input_schema.name: initialize_with_readme
input_schema.description: Whether to initialize repository with a README file (true/false)
